label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: a tierra manante leche y miel, porque no subiré en medio de ti, porque pueblo duro de nuca tú, no sea que te consuma en el camino.
spanish: a tierra manante leche y miel, porque no subiré en medio de ti, porque pueblo duro de nuca tú, no sea que yo te consuma en el camino.
grammarChanges: Added the explicit subject pronoun 'yo' before 'te consuma' because the Spanish present-subjunctive form 'consuma' is identical for 1st and 3rd person singular; the Hebrew Piel imperfect 1cs with 2ms suffix is unambiguous (the speaker consumes you), so the added pronoun restores that clarity without changing participants or stem force.
readerNote: Added 'yo' to disambiguate the subjunctive 'consuma', which is otherwise identical in 1st and 3rd person; the Hebrew 1cs form confirms the subject is the speaker, not a 3rd party.
